name: @brushy/di-bench
description: Benchmarks for @brushy/di-core vs tsyringe, inversify, awilix

scripts.bench: pnpm --filter @brushy/di-core run build && pnpm run build && node --max-old-space-size=8192 --import reflect-metadata dist/bench.js
scripts.bench:quick: pnpm --filter @brushy/di-core run build && pnpm run build && BENCH_TIME_MS=1000 BENCH_RUNS=1 node --max-old-space-size=4096 --import reflect-metadata dist/bench.js
scripts.prebench: pnpm --filter @brushy/di-core run build && pnpm run build
